source_admission: Published values used as constants, fitted data or cited findings; no external dataset files are admitted. Three literature-gathering agents fetched and quoted the sources on 28 September 2026, reading scanned reports and figures where noted; values read from a published figure say so. Secondary sources are marked. Model products of this repository are cited by path in the README and hashed in the results.
